title: "Kaizen Experiments"
subtitle: "Next Steps"
---

## Run, Learn, and Operationalize

Treat the experiment roadmap as a living scientific record[cite: 11]. Before starting a pilot test, confirm its lead bioacoustician/owner, dataset scope (e.g., specific cruise legs or mooring deployments), baseline metrics ($PT$ in hr/TB, %C&A accuracy), success criteria, and compute/hardware constraints[cite: 11]. During the pilot run, record execution logs, compute credit usage, false-positive counts, and analyst time spent on verification[cite: 11].

---

## Establish a Bioacoustic Review Cadence

Choose a review rhythm that aligns with field deployment schedules and scientific reporting windows[cite: 11]:

- **Pilot Syncs (Weekly / Bi-Weekly):** Hold brief check-ins during active model testing or script trials to surface compute bottlenecks, script errors, or clock-drift anomalies[cite: 11].
- **Cruise & Survey Debriefs:** Review pilot results immediately following major vessel recovery charters or glider landings to decide whether to scale new workflows to incoming media[cite: 11].
- **Verification Reviews:** Evaluate measured pilot results against baseline performance prior to major management reporting deadlines (e.g., Marine Mammal Protection Act stock assessments or biological opinions)[cite: 11]. Include field engineers, analysts, and senior bioacousticians to ensure speed gains do not compromise detection accuracy[cite: 11].
- **Annual VSM Baseline Review:** Re-evaluate program-wide value streams annually to update baseline processing capacities, integrate mature deep-learning models, and re-align targets[cite: 11].

---

## Review Each Pilot Result

- **Adopt:** The pilot result validates the hypothesis (e.g., AI pre-screening cuts analyst review time by 50% while maintaining >90% recall)[cite: 11]. Containerize the script and deploy it as standard practice across all program data streams[cite: 11].
- **Adapt:** The pilot yielded promising evidence, but classifier confidence thresholds, clock-drift algorithms, or metadata schemas require tuning before full deployment[cite: 11].
- **Abandon:** The test failed to close the target gap or introduced critical issues—such as excessive false positives or unrecoverable audio header corruption[cite: 11].

Do not mark an experiment completed based solely on finishing script execution[cite: 11]. Verify the underlying scientific quality metrics, audit downstream NCEI metadata compatibility, and document lessons learned[cite: 11].

---

## Feed Pilot Results into the Next PAM Baseline

When a pilot improvement is validated and adopted[cite: 11]:

1. **Preserve Supporting Evidence:** Archive execution logs, model benchmark datasets, and time-tracking records alongside `kaizen-experiments.csv`[cite: 11].
2. **Update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs):** Document updated analyst guidelines, PAMGuard/Triton configuration profiles, and containerized script repos.
3. **Establish a New Current State Baseline:** Record the new $PT$ (hr/TB) and %C&A accuracy rates in a timestamped metadata entry[cite: 11]. Do not overwrite historical baseline evidence[cite: 11].
4. **Update the Value Stream Map:** Revise the Current State Map if data pathways, manual handoffs, or compute queues have structurally changed[cite: 11].
5. **Initiate the Next PDCA Cycle:** Re-export `gap-analysis.csv` to identify remaining bottlenecks and launch the next iteration of program improvements[cite: 11].

---

## Complete the NOAA Passive Acoustics VSM Suite

- [ ] **Data & Analysis Family Process Matrix:** Group acoustic projects (Moorings, Gliders, Towed Arrays, Telemetered Buoys) into standardized value streams[cite: 11].
- [ ] **Current State Map:** Document present data ingestion, detection, analyst review, and archival flows with timestamped metadata[cite: 11].
- [ ] **Future State Map:** Design automated processing targets, cloud triggers, and streamlined QA/QC review pathways[cite: 11].
- [ ] **Gap Analysis:** Quantify process deltas ($\Delta$) across processing time, lead time, and first-pass accuracy (%C&A)[cite: 11].
- [ ] **Kaizen Experiments:** Assign clear hypotheses, owners, pilot action steps, and target success metrics to high-priority gaps[cite: 11].
- [ ] **Execute & Operationalize:** Run pilot tests through Plan, Do, Check, and Act; document decision outcomes (Adopt/Adapt/Abandon)[cite: 11].
- [ ] **Preserve Project Artifacts:** Store exported `.csv`, `.json`, `.drawio`, and `.drawio.svg` files in the project `output/` directory[cite: 11].
